purpose: Qualify the generated AC1021 tilted planar control-point SPLINE through installed dwg2dxf and FreeCAD's native C++ DXF importer.

source.provenance: Generated from scratch under the system temporary directory; no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

convertedDxf.splineInspection: The emitted SPLINE retains degree 2, the six authored knots, all three group-10 WCS control points and the calculated group-210 plane normal.

consumer.route: FreeCAD Draft DWG open/insert -> hash-checked installed dwg2dxf -> C++ DXF importer

splineBoundBox.tightBoundComparison: not used; the same conservative Y bound occurs for a direct Part.BSplineCurve construction even though its sampled geometry matches the quadratic

directConstructionCrossCheck.method: Part.BSplineCurve.buildFromPolesMultsKnots with poles, multiplicities [3,3], knots [0,1], nonperiodic degree 2
directConstructionCrossCheck.interpretation: The matching direct construction shows the failed initial assertion was caused by using a non-tight kernel BoundBox as the exact curve oracle; it does not indicate an imported curve mismatch.

validation.generatorAndMacro: Local source generator, installed converter handoff and FreeCAD import assertions completed for both operations.
validation.fixturePolicy: All generated DWG/DXF files stayed in isolated temporary directories; none was committed.

authority.relevantField: Autodesk documents SPLINE group 10 control points as WCS values.

limitations: This qualifies one generated AC1021 spline profile and FreeCAD 1.1.4 macOS ARM64 only.
The conservative BoundBox is not used as a tight curve bound; semantic checks use normalized parameter samples, edge topology and length.
Hosted FreeCAD 1.1.3 Linux/Windows execution, other spline profiles/revisions, physical producer breadth and broad native support remain open.
supportClaimEffect: Adds bounded local FreeCAD geometry evidence for this generated AC1021 SPLINE profile only; no broad format-support claim is promoted.
